plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control skin DE + pathway analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: Only a gene-level TPM table from Salmon was delivered (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 lesional, 6 control skin; no raw counts, no quantification directories). Per the grounded knowledge-service procedure for TPM-only bulk RNA-seq input, count-based tools (DESeq2/edgeR/voom) are inappropriate because they assume raw integer counts with negative-binomial variance; the correct path is: (1) QC sample structure on log2(TPM+1) values via PCA/MDS and sample-distance heatmap to confirm the 6-vs-6 groups separate and to catch outliers or mislabeling before any modeling, since no batch variable exists to control for; (2) filter genes below a 1 TPM floor in fewer than 6 samples (the smaller group size); (3) log2(TPM+1) transform only — no size-factor or TMM normalization, since TPM already carries within-sample scaling; (4) fit a limma linear model (lmFit) on log2(TPM+1) with an explicit factor (control as reference level) and the contrast lesional-vs-control; (5) moderate variance with eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) to protect against hypervariable genes, appropriate because the input approximates continuous log-normal data rather than counts; (6) select DE genes by BH-adjusted p-value (padj < 0.05), not by raw p-value or fold-change alone; (7) run over-representation analysis (not preranked GSEA — the knowledge-check flagged fgsea/GSEA as not permitted for this situation) against MSigDB Hallmark gene sets using the tested-gene universe, since the significant-gene list size will only be known after the DE step and ORA with an explicit universe was the check-validated method; (8) synthesize a report naming the design, thresholds, package versions, n tested, n DE, and enrichment parameters. Caveats stated throughout: no raw counts limits length-bias correction (tximport offsets cannot be reconstructed from TPM alone), strandedness is unknown and cannot be verified retrospectively without FASTQ/BAM, and TPM comparability assumes a single consistent library protocol across all 12 samples (single batch, per profile).
